language_task: Pick up the blue rectangular block and stack it onto the yellow object.
outcome_evidence: Frames 76–90 in wrist_cam and right_base_cam show the blue block acquired and lifted; frames 110–163 show it transported toward the yellow object. In frames 164–240, wrist_cam shows the blue block remaining between the closed fingers, while left_base_cam and right_base_cam show no completed release or withdrawal from a stable stack. Completion is unconfirmed rather than a visibly dropped or toppled placement; the final prolonged hold does not complete the task.

failure_annotations.explanation: After approaching the yellow object, the robot holds the blue block in essentially the same placement-area pose through frame 240, with only small adjustments and no release or meaningful stacking progress. This sustained stall is visible in wrist_cam at frames 164, 180, 200, 220 and 240 and corroborated by left_base_cam and right_base_cam; no hidden cause is established.
failure_annotations.recovery: Reassess the blue block’s alignment with the yellow support, center and lower it into stable contact, then release and withdraw after confirming support; no human intervention is visibly necessary.
failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The block remains retained, and no dropping, damage or disruption to other objects is visible during frames 164–240.
failure_annotations.resetability_evidence: The robot can resume placement from the retained-block state; no cleanup, object retrieval or human environmental reset is visibly required.
